title: a step turned off queues, never drops

setup.note: A mature world (20 spaces, consent 30 days old) so the live lane runs on the preset window. Settings › Intelligence switches the Orient step OFF (app_state process_enabled_orient = "0"). Three live messages arrive on one WhatsApp stream and the cold window comes due.

input_events: Rohan: sending the upi id now (live, WhatsApp)
the cold window comes due while Orient is off; ticks continue for two hold periods
Orient is switched back ON and the dispatcher ticks once more

wrong.label: dropped
wrong.assert_absent: an event stamped dispatched, dead-lettered, or given an attempt row while its step was off

wrong.label: called-while-off
wrong.assert_absent: a sink (model) call made while the step was off

wrong.label: lost-on-resume
wrong.assert_absent: fewer events reaching the sink after the step is switched back on than were queued

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.21 SET-01 · a step turned off queues, never drops
